name: Adventure Training for Youth
benefit: Under this scheme, free training is provided to the youth of the state in various adventure-based activities such as White Water River Rafting Guide Training, Disaster Management and Disaster Rescue Operations, First Aid, Burma Bridge, Trekking, etc.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a male or female. 1. The applicant must be between 15 to 30 years of age as on 1st March, 2023. 1. The applicant must have passed at least class 8th.1. The applicant must be physically fit to undergo adventure training. 1. The applicant must not be suffering from Heart disease, Asthma, Epilepsy, or have rods implanted in arms or legs. 1. The applicant will be given preference if they belong to volunteer of PARD, member of NSS, NCC, member/official of Yuvak or Mahila Mangal Dal.
